name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from overload and keep working even when the connection drops. The app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: your team runs service with this tool.

Customers place an order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare, then mark the order as ready and handed over.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU WON’T MAKE
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at one time and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches what the kitchen can do.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE WINDOW
Add orders placed on the spot to the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what’s next and what’s ready, and gives an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINTING ORDER TICKETS
Connect the kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP WORKING EVEN WHEN THE CONNECTION DROPS
Switch on offline protection: if the connection drops, ordering ahead pauses, so nobody can place an order you won’t see. Orders taken on the device are kept and synced when the connection is restored.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on an iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
whatsNew:
HatchGrab is now available in 60 languages.

Print order tickets not only over Bluetooth but also from a kitchen printer on the local network.

Bugs fixed and improvements made.
shortDescription: Pre-orders from a food truck, collection time and a kitchen screen.
